about: Reviewed English replacements for the journal's user notes and image captions. Keys are stable review item IDs. Only these items are published; every other user note and caption is dropped.

rules.language: professional English, first person, no hype
rules.leverage: high leverage is part of the strategy; risk is low margin with a precise entry, so leverage alone is not a drop reason
rules.drop: weak reasoning, a widened stop, or a duplicate copy on an unfilled order
